description: Step 1 of the MCPYP selection funnel (broad search). Returns a broad pool of candidate servers for a task (default 20, paged with offset) plus the total match count. Use this first to see the shape of the pool, then narrow with refine. Pass the same journey_id across explore, refine, and pick so the journey is logged as one funnel. Optional no_key_required narrows the pool to servers usable without a publisher API key. Most callers can skip the funnel and use find_mcp + get_mcp instead.

journey_id.description: Optional client-chosen id linking this journey's steps

no_key_required.description: Only servers verified usable without a publisher API key (a successful keyless call on record)

offset.description: Page offset into the ranked pool

name: explore
